practice.prompt: In right triangle ABC, ∠B=90°, the side opposite ∠A is 12 cm and adjacent is 16 cm. Find sin A exactly.
practice.memo: Mark ∠B=90° and identify ∠A as the reference angle. Label the side opposite A 12 cm and the adjacent side 16 cm. Find the hypotenuse: √(12²+16²) = 20 cm. Use sin A = opposite/hypotenuse = 12/20. Answer: sin A = 3/5. Check 12²+16²=20².
